name: Steel Werx
audience: Property managers, architects, labs, event/brand teams, homeowners
description: Santa Clara metal shop: TIG/MIG welding, tube bending and notching, plasma and contour cutting, powder coating, stainless fabrication, mobile on-location welding, art installation, and one-off commercial problem solving.
serviceCopy: Mobile welding — we rig it on site.
insight: Own copy says customers arrive after being told "we can't do that" elsewhere — that is the brand thesis.
usps: "The shop that says yes" — takes what others refuse
Full process coverage: cut, bend, weld, coat, install
Mobile welding means they come to you
differentiators: Fabricator + artist + service company in one, currently presented as a keyword dump

reputation.note: Researchers and builders cite it as the go-to for awkward one-off metal work.

afford: Commercial signage and railing contracts are $5K–$150K
B2B + B2C mix needs two funnels — a site, not a page
62–63 photos and 86 reviews already exist as content
Instagram + Tumblr history shows willingness to market
risk: Owner (Pawl W.) is the brand — needs a person-led structure
Yahoo email signals informality to architects

art.logo: Tumbler/weld-glyph mark; existing name is strong
art.photoNote: Spark and grind photography; process close-ups

copy.h1: If another shop told you it cannot be done, bring us the drawing.
copy.sub: Railings, gates, signage, art and impossible one-offs — cut, bent, welded, powder-coated and installed by one Santa Clara crew.
copy.lede: Steel Werx has spent twenty years building the things other shops decline. The website people judge them on, though, is a keyword wall from 2015 with an expired copyright.
svcCopy: Mobile welding — we rig it on site.

concept.dir: Fabrication-floor brutalism: 12-column blueprint grid, process ledger, capability matrix with tolerances, "send a STEP/PDF" intake.
interactive: Capability matrix rows with process tags
concept.refs: Machine-shop spec sheets meet an artist-run space.

web.note: Site is live but HTTP-only on a 2010s page-builder: keyword-wall body copy ("Need 10,000 Holes Punched in a Pinch? Please Phone Pawl!"), copyright "2005 - 2015", no mobile-first CSS, images not optimised, contact is a Yahoo address. Zero conversion path for commercial buyers.

photoAlt: Concept artwork for Steel Werx — generated design direction, not a photograph of the premises

design.label: Shop Floor Brutalist
design.summary: Heavy concrete/steel aesthetic: oversized numerals, blueprint rules, stamp-like buttons, horizontal material ticker. Built for fabricators and builders.
